        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_treasury_payer value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_personal_payer value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_recipient value = this }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_approver value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_frozen_owner value = var:zg361_case_af_owner }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_frozen_subject value = this }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_frozen_cycle value = var:zg361_case_af_cycle_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_frozen_case value = var:zg361_case_af_case_serial }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_frozen_state value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_m300_buyback_gross value = 10 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_comp_financial_applied value = 1 }
    }
}
